notes: γάμους → *a marriage feast* heads on *marriage* under rule 66's generic-completion arm, exactly as `ἀγάπαις` → *love feasts* heads on *love*.
μήποτε takes the supplied frame *lest haply* whole, headed on the subordinating word *lest*.
ἐντιμότερός is anarthrous and substantival, so *man* is the generic completion and rule 17 keeps the head on the adjective.
